verdict.rationale: Kick documents native invoicing: users can create and send invoices directly from Kick, and view invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring invoice schedules or automatic overdue payment reminders. Creating a one-off invoice is not the same as a recurring schedule, so the documented invoicing earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers
